 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:

ORDER This petition is filed by the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 2 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., for quashing the criminal proceedings in C.C.No.36837/2022 pending on the file of XXXVII ACMM, Bengaluru arising out of Crime No.220/2022 registered by Basavanagudi Women Police station and charge sheeted for the offence punishable under Section 498A, 504 of IPC and sections 3 and 4 Dowry Prohibition Act NC: 2024:KHC:2298 2.
During the pendency of the petition both petitioner and respondent No.2 appeared through their counsel and filed joint compromise application under Section 482 read 320 of Cr.P.C.

They also submitted that in the family court, both petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 have filed joint divorce petition under Section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act and matter was referred to the Mediation Centre and it is settled.
Also submits, part of the permanent alimony has been paid and remaining will be paid at the time of passing judgment by the family court.
3. The submission of both counsel and parties are placed on record.
